headline: Santander México Names Ángel Alverde Losada as Chairman of the Board of Directors
summary: Santander México appointed Ángel Alverde Losada as chairman of its board of directors, effective February 5, 2027, when Laura Diez Barroso Azcárraga's term ends.
why: Santander México is the Mexican unit of Spain's Santander Group, one of the largest banks in Mexico, so its governance changes matter to banking-sector investors.
original_headline: Santander México nombra a Ángel Alverde Losada como presidente del Consejo de Administración
